note: Demo method based on IPCC default factors. NOT an official carbon standard. factors-1.1 (Oct 2026): growth for continental Asia corrected from 2.0 to 1.5 (2.0 is the insular Asia value) and sources corrected to the IPCC 2006 tables they come from. Values were checked against a published summary of the IPCC tables, not yet against the printed IPCC page, so verified stays false.

carbon_fraction.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.3 (default carbon fraction 0.47)

tropical_dry_forest_asia.label: Tropical dry forest, Asia
tropical_dry_forest_asia.growth_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.9: above-ground net biomass growth, natural tropical dry forest, Asia continental, older than 20 years (1.5 t d.m./ha/yr). Insular Asia is 2.0.
tropical_dry_forest_asia.root_shoot_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.4: tropical dry forest, above-ground biomass over 20 t/ha (0.28). The 2019 Refinement gives 0.44 for natural tropical dry forest in Asia; we keep the lower 2006 value, so credits err on the low side.

tropical_moist_deciduous_asia.label: Tropical moist deciduous forest, Asia
tropical_moist_deciduous_asia.growth_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.9. NOT CHECKED: used only when a check asks for this zone by name.
tropical_moist_deciduous_asia.root_shoot_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 4, Ch. 4, Table 4.4. NOT CHECKED: used only when a check asks for this zone by name.

unsupported_note: Credits are not estimated here: carbon factors are only set up for tropical dry forest in peninsular and central India.
